text: Garro is a battle-captain of the Death Guard whose understanding of duty places him at odds with the betrayal at Isstvan. He acts to preserve witnesses and carry a warning, taking command of the escape aboard the Eisenstein.

He works with warriors, crew and civilians including [[euphrati-keeler|Keeler]] as the damaged ship faces pursuit and corruption in the warp. The cost of the voyage forces him to place his loyalty to the Emperor above his Legion’s commands.

Rescued by Imperial Fists, Garro presents his account to Rogal Dorn and endures the primarch’s initial disbelief. Reaching Terra makes it possible for the warning to be heard; it also leaves Garro needing a new purpose beyond his old command.
